title: Health Inspector Tuesday
text: Surprise inspection during the lunch rush.

title: The Food Critic
text: A feared critic booked a table under a fake name. Staff spotted them.

outcome.narration: They must disclose it; review void, mild embarrassment.

title: Recipe Walkout
text: Your head chef quits… for Marco. The signature dish walks with them.

outcome.narration: Dish stays, they get sued if used.

title: Cold Chain Gamble
text: The freezer truck died overnight. The stock is… probably fine.

title: Cart Abandon Mystery
text: 70% abandon at checkout. Something in the flow is broken or scary.

title: Marketplace Squeeze
text: The big marketplace raises its take rate to 25%.

choices.label: Both + raise prices on marketplace only

title: The Returns Tsunami
text: Serial returners are bleeding you; one influencer teaches "the trick."

title: Packaging Identity
text: Unboxing videos are free ads — if the box deserves it.

title: Store Rejection
text: The app store rejects your update over a vague guideline.

title: The Churn Cliff
text: Day-30 retention is a cliff. Investors will ask.

title: Open Source Fork
text: Your free tier just got cloned as an open-source project. It's popular.

title: The Data Center Bill
text: Cloud costs doubled with usage. Success is expensive.

title: The Algorithm Favors You
text: One video prints. A million new eyes. They expect this weekly now.

choices.label: Use the spike to funnel owned channels

title: Brand Deal Dilemma
text: A big sponsor pays 3S. Their product is… not good.

title: Copyright Strike
text: A strike lands on your best-performing piece. Fair use is a gray zone.

title: The Ghostwriter Question
text: You can't make everything yourself anymore.

choices.label: Build a writers' room, credit them

title: Drop Day Chaos
text: Bots bought 60% of the drop in 90 seconds. Real fans got nothing.

title: The Knockoff Haul Video
text: A viral video says the fake "is basically the same."

title: Celebrity Stylist DM
text: A stylist wants free pieces for an A-lister. No promises.

title: Season vs Seasonless
text: Fashion calendar says 4 collections/yr. Your team says 2 good ones.

title: Crunch Decision
text: Launch is close. The industry's ugly word is in the room: crunch.

title: Monetization Fork
text: Publisher pressure: add aggressive microtransactions?

title: The Streamer Effect
text: A giant streamer plays your game unprompted. Servers are melting.

title: Patch or Content
text: Players demand bug fixes; the roadmap promises new content. Team does one.

outcome.narration: Both mediocre this Q, then fine.

title: Injury Claim
text: A member says your equipment/program injured them.

title: The Transformation Post
text: A member's before/after goes viral, crediting you.

title: Supplement Money
text: A supplement brand offers 2S/yr for exclusive promotion. Ingredients: mostly hope.

choices.label: Take it with third-party testing demand
Decline, sell your own tested line

title: January Tsunami
text: Resolution season triples signups. February will triple cancellations.

title: The Reaction Reports
text: A small % of customers report skin reactions to a bestseller.

title: Shade Range Callout
text: A viral post: your range excludes deeper skin tones.

title: Dupe Culture Hit
text: A drugstore dupe of your hero product trends.

choices.label: Launch your own budget sister brand

title: The Clean Beauty Audit
text: A watchdog grades brands on ingredient claims. Yours are… enthusiastic.

title: The School District Pilot
text: A district offers a pilot: 10 schools, brutal procurement, slow pay.

title: Cheating Headline
text: A news story: students use tools like yours to cheat.

choices.label: Ship academic-integrity features, join the panel discussion

title: Efficacy Study Ask
text: Districts want proof your product improves outcomes. A real study costs 2S and might say "meh."

title: Summer Cliff
text: School's out. Usage falls off a cliff every summer.

choices.label: Accept seasonality, cut costs in summer

title: Greenwash Accusation
text: An activist thread audits your claims. Two of seven don't hold up.

title: The Cheaper Gray Option
text: A supplier offers non-certified materials at −30%. Nobody would know. (You would.)

title: Certification Maze
text: The credible eco-label costs 1S and a year of audits.

title: The Oil Money Offer
text: A fossil-fuel giant's venture arm offers 10S. The optics write themselves.

choices.label: Take it, spend it loudly on mission

title: Safety Test Surprise
text: A component fails a choking-hazard test margin. Barely.

title: Scalper Economy
text: Your limited figure resells at 5×. Kids can't get it; flippers can.

title: The License Temptation
text: A giant franchise offers a license: guaranteed sales, 18% royalty, creative shackles.

title: Holiday Bet
text: Retailers want holiday orders NOW: how much do you commit to produce?

title: The Recall Scare
text: A competitor's recall makes owners paranoid about the whole category.

title: Vet Endorsement Path
text: Clinical credibility costs: a vet advisory board wants 0.5S/yr.

title: The Emotional Support Story
text: A customer credits your product in a tearjerker story about their elderly dog. It's spreading.

choices.label: Amplify with their consent, donate to shelters

title: Subscription Fatigue
text: Your subscription boxes churn as pets (and owners) get bored.
